posts.hook: We're managing social media free for 3 Gainesville businesses. 3 months. 3 spots.
posts.facebook:
We're managing social media free for 3 Gainesville businesses. 3 months. 3 spots.
Call Alex at 904-210-1071 or message us here to claim a spot.

For businesses in Gainesville and Alachua County.

What you get, free for 3 months:
- 3 posts a week on Facebook and Instagram (2 reels or carousels, plus 1 tip or carousel)
- A monthly content plan you approve before anything is made
- A short monthly results report: reach, engagement, and clicks to your site
- Captions, music and scheduling, handled

What we ask:
- Approve each month's plan within 2 business days
- Add us as a manager in Meta so we can post, and send real photos or footage when we ask
- Let us share your results as a case study, and a short review if you are happy
- An honest check-in at the end of month 3

After 3 months: $600 a month, month to month. Pilot businesses keep $600 locked for as long as they stay. No auto-billing, no contract, cancel any time. You continue only if it is paying off.

What it is not: no paid ads or ad spend, no promised follower or sales numbers, and you keep replying to your own comments and messages.

Alex picks the 3 best fits from everyone who calls or messages. No contract. No card.

See our work: https://ka-performancefl.com/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-09-26-4

The music is AI generated.

#GainesvilleFL #AlachuaCounty #SmallBusiness #SocialMediaManagement #GainesvilleBusiness
